name: Vinh Citadel
kicker: A Nguyễn gate, a moat, and the yard
summary: Walk what remains of the Nguyễn citadel: a gate, a moat, and the yard, not a reconstructed palace. Earth in 1804 under Gia Long, stone in Minh Mạng’s 12th year, 1831. The city page prints a six-sided wall, 2,412 m around, 4.42 m high. The Xô viết museum is in the yard, nearly 2 km from the square. A gate hour and a fee were not printed.
timeNeeded: A walk around the gate and the moat
getThere: Nearly 2 km from the square, with the Xô viết museum in the yard.
heroCaption: The citadel gate in daylight, the full gate. The moat is not in this frame.

notice.title: Do not budget a full fort
notice.body: The city roundup is a gate, a moat rebuilt as a lit lake with a grass bank, and the yard. It is not a reconstructed palace.

body: Walk the gate. The city introduction prints a six-sided wall, perimeter 603 trượng (2,412 m), height 4.42 m, area 420,000 m², and a moat 28 m wide and 3.20 m deep. Earth in 1804 under Gia Long, stone in Minh Mạng’s 12th year, 1831. The roundup says the moat has been rebuilt as a lit lake with a grass bank. These photographs show the gate. They do not show the moat.

The city roundup places the gate as the check-in, and says the walls stand in Cửa Nam, Đội Cung, and Quang Trung on older ward names. Cửa Nam and Quang Trung go into phường Thành Vinh from 1 July 2025. Đội Cung was not in the six clauses that loaded. Ask for Thành cổ, not for a vanished ward. The Xô viết museum sits in the yard, nearly 2 km from the square on the 2025 news page. It is not Bảo tàng Nghệ An, which the roundup places on Đào Tấn.

Come late in the afternoon if you want the moat lights the roundup describes. Hours of any gate were not printed. Check on arrival. A fee was not loaded. Do not plan this as a palace visit. Huế is the citadel day. This is the gate that is left.
